name: Spearmint
use: Fresh tea, and it spreads everywhere.
description: Spearmint has bright green, crinkled leaves and a fresh, sweet flavour, milder than peppermint. It spreads quickly by underground runners, so it is best grown in a pot or in a bed with a barrier. Pick the tips often and it grows bushier.
imageAlt: A spearmint stem with pointed, green leaves in pairs.
